facts.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's map.

Grimny's ghost said Bral probably hid the dwarves' mine hoard in the cave labeled "Dragon's Lair" on the party's map. The dwarves had scouted it as a hiding spot: very small, one big room, and empty when they visited.
The dragon the town fears reportedly lairs in the Dragon's Lair cave where the treasure is probably hidden, standing between the party and the treasure.
facts.uncertain_reason: Grimny found the cave empty when the dwarves scouted it, and Dunk suspects there is no dragon at all (beat_78).

facts.text: Dr. Uriah can now read languages, letting him read the label under one location on the treasure map per day.
